title: Nogeun-ri massacre
note: US 7th Cavalry killing of refugees at a railway bridge; 250-300 dead by memorial count; Army 2001 review versus AP/Hanley; Korean survivors' decades of petitions.

title: Bodo League massacres
note: Mass executions of prisoners and enrolled leftists by South Korean forces, June-September 1950; Truth and Reconciliation Commission findings; range 3,400 confirmed to c. 200,000 alleged.

title: Inchon landing (Operation Chromite)
note: Amphibious landing of 15 September 1950; X Corps; tides; Seoul retaken 28 September; consequences for Chinese decision.

title: Chinese People's Volunteers enter the Korean War
note: Politburo decision of 13 October 1950, Yalu crossing 19 October; Chen Jian, Shen Zhihua and Kim debates; Soviet air cover.

title: Korean Armistice Agreement
note: Signed at Panmunjom 27 July 1953; DMZ; POW repatriation dispute; Neutral Nations commissions; no peace treaty.

title: Women in the Korean War: Volunteer Troops of Korean Women and military comfort stations
note: Lee Im Ha (2006): Volunteer Troops of Women founded Aug 1950; Special Comfort Squads 1951-54; UN comfort houses; women's wartime labour. Needs further Korean-language scholarship.

title: Jeju uprising and massacres
note: Precursor violence in the divided south before the war; ROK repression; truth commission findings.

title: Hungnam evacuation of North Korean refugees
note: December 1950 evacuation of UN troops and North Korean civilians from Hungnam after the Chinese offensive; origin of many separated families; verify figures from sources.
